Refunds for orders 250 and 251 are present; order 255 refund is not recorded as expected. Now get net_balance per customer (acme, birch, cobalt) and record one payout per customer.

Have net balances for all customers. Record payouts for acme 5519, birch 13637, cobalt 53824. No hold needed since refunds failure should already be reflected in net balances.
